title: Weirs Beach Go-Kart Track

services.name: Weirs Beach Go-Kart Track
services.desc: Weirs Beach Go-Kart Track is located at 582 Endicott Street North in Laconia, New Hampshire, directly across from Funspot and just one mile from Weirs Beach. Our convenient location makes it easy to add go-kart racing to a day of exploring the Lakes Region and Lake Winnipesaukee. Yes! We are located directly across from Funspot in Laconia. Many visitors enjoy racing go-karts before or after spending time at one of the area’s most popular attractions. Click here for directions. We are open weekends from noon to 6:00 PM beginning May 30. Starting June 21 through Labor Day, we are open daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM. At this time, tickets are available for purchase at our ticket window only.
